Definition: to cover; by implication, to veil, to encase, protect
BiblicalUsage: 1) to cover, overlay, wainscotted, covered with boards or panelling; 1a) (Qal) to cover; 1b)(Niphal) to be covered; 1c) (Piel) to cover, overlay
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
